title: Weekly English Review
summary: This week's news highlights significant developments across various sectors, including the automotive industry, air travel disruptions, federal funding regulations, economic indicators, espionage concerns, and sports broadcasting strategies. Hyundai is expected to outperform Ford in sales due to a lack of hybrid options from Detroit automakers. A Nor'easter has caused widespread flight delays, prompting airlines to waive change fees for affected passengers. In legal news, a judge ruled that the federal government cannot withhold counterterrorism funds to enforce election administration changes. Meanwhile, YouTube is focusing on acquiring live sports rights to enhance its offerings in a competitive market.
